instruction: You are facing towards the wall, turn slight left and move towards the open door. Now move out of the room. Turn left and move forward. Turn slight left and move towards the open door. You are facing towards the open door, turn slight right and move in the path. Turn slight left and move towards the open door which is opposite to you. Turn slight right and enter into the room. Now walk straight towards the open glass door. Move out of the room. Turn left and move towards the middle pillar. Turn slight left and move towards the pillar which is opposite to you. You are facing towards the pool and to your right there is a pillar, which is your final destination.
